meta.title: An out-of-office auto-reply never gets a reply back (no loop)
gaps: Set an out-of-office auto-reply on Asha's mailbox.
Log in as Ravi and create the named event with the specified two-step approval workflow.
Submit the event for approval and deliver the approval email to Asha.
Wait for and inspect the auto-reply in the approval mailbox.
Observe the mailbox for 10 minutes and verify that no bounce-back, approval action, or email ping-pong occurs.
Use the specified DLF Hospitality UAT users and separate mailboxes.
